resources.string: Park safely before testing. Capture a baseline, change ONE thing using the car controls, choose its label below, then capture again. Return here after using another screen. Raw values and differences are evidence, not proof of a command mapping. Reports stay on this device unless you share them.
Optional observation: which screen changed, window position, etc.
No captures yet. Start with a baseline. No vehicle commands run automatically.

Climate OFF sends a real command and leaves climate off; restore it using the car controls. Display dimming (10%, never zero) changes the real centre display and restores on touch, leaving this screen, or after 10 seconds. Screen off sends the car\'s own Screen off shortcut command; touch the screen to wake it. Close windows raises all four side windows (car must be ON); STOP WINDOWS is always available and halts them immediately. DRL OFF works only in Park; use Restore to turn them back on. Vehicle-theme writes remain locked until their meanings are verified.

Vehicle parked, no occupants or pets relying on climate control? This turns the whole climate system OFF and does not restore it automatically. The report records the command result and a delayed read-back.

Car in Park? This turns the daytime running lights OFF (the car only changes them in Park). They stay off until you tap Restore or switch them back on in the car settings. Check local rules before driving with them off.
Tap anywhere to restore the display\nAutomatically restores after 10 seconds
This sends the same command as the car\'s own Screen off shortcut, turning the centre display off. Touch the screen to wake it, as with the shortcut.
Recording. Straight away, press the car\'s own Screen off shortcut, wake the screen again, come back to this page and tap Finish recording and show log.

Car switched ON and parked? Make sure no hands, arms, pets or objects are in any window opening. This raises all four side windows. Use STOP WINDOWS to halt them. The report records the command result and the window positions as they close.
Delete this session\'s captures and baseline? This does not undo vehicle settings.
The report includes display settings, raw vehicle readings and your observations. Review it before sharing. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
